name: NMDC Limited
about: NMDC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, explores for and produces iron ore in India and internationally. It operates through Iron Ore, and All Other Segments (Pellets, Other Minerals & Services). The company also explores for lithium, copper, rock phosphate, limestone, beach sand, coking and non-coking coal, magnesite, diamond, tungsten, nickel, gold, base metals, and rare earth metals. In addition, it produces and sells hot rolled coil and pellets; and generates and distributes solar and wind power. The company exports its products. NMDC Limited was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
